summary: The example inventory for a 2.4 multi-node controller upgrade to 2.6 enterprise adds two [automationgateway] hosts and keeps two [automationcontroller] hosts with peers=execution_nodes and [execution_nodes] with a hop node (node_type='hop') and two execution nodes, plus new hub and EDA groups.
